Tests XDP packet processing for RX, routing, GRE, fragmentation, and TX paths.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the network XDP tile. It builds a mock `fd_topo_t` topology, creates a workspace, and initializes the data structures that the tile uses for packet I/O, routing, neighbor lookup, and device state. The code sets up `fd_fib4` routing tables, an `fd_neigh4_hmap` neighbor table, a netdev table, XDP rings, and UMEM-backed packet buffers. It also defines fixed IP addresses, MAC addresses, interface indexes, and GRE tunnel endpoints so the test can drive known packet paths.

The [`main`](<#main>) function runs a sequence of packet-processing checks against the tile callbacks `before_credit`, `before_frag`, `during_frag`, and `after_frag`. It feeds in crafted Ethernet, IPv4, UDP, and GRE packets, then verifies that the tile removes or adds GRE headers, selects the correct route, fills MAC addresses, sets source IP addresses, and publishes TX frames with the expected contents. The loop covers GRE and non-GRE cases for two interfaces, so the file acts as an integration test for XDP receive and transmit handling in the network tile.
